summary: V3.1 Category-Aware Scoring Engine — Moneycontrol debt-fund pipeline verified end-to-end via live backend (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). 20/20 new pytest unit tests pass (14 in test_moneycontrol_client.py, 6 in test_v3_debt_scoring.py). Admin API GET /api/admin/v3-master-funds returns exactly 36 debt funds with moneycontrol_imid populated AND credit_quality_score, duration_risk_score, investment_style fields in the primitives block — matches main agent's expected count. All 36 debt funds have quality_breakdown.category='debt' and the duration_risk/credit_quality components in the breakdown exactly match the primitives' duration_risk_score/credit_quality_score (36/36), proving _norm_duration_risk_flex() prefers the pre-normalised score and the debt routing wires through compute_quality_score. V3 insights pipeline (/api/insights/v3-portfolio) exposes the new debt primitives keys (credit_quality_score, duration_risk_score, ytm, modified_duration, investment_style, moneycontrol_imid) inside each fund's primitives block — confirmed via priyankamantri's portfolio (values null because her 26 holdings are all equity/hybrid; no debt fund overlap). bulk_import_moneycontrol_debt --limit 3 --dry-run completes in 0.4s, hits 3 live moneycontrol pages, and logs cq/dr/style for all 3 funds with no errors. 0 non-debt funds carry moneycontrol_imid (correct skip behaviour). 69 previous V3 tests (test_v3_scoring/test_v3_weights/test_v3_explainer/test_admin_v3_master) still pass — zero regression.
critical_code_review_comments: v3_integration.py exposes new debt primitives correctly; for users with no debt funds the keys appear with null values which is the expected schema-stable contract. Frontend should treat missing/null as 'no data' rather than '0'.

bulk_import_moneycontrol_debt is a one-off data-load (correctly NOT auto-run by tests). Re-runs against the live moneycontrol pages will respect the pacing in the autosuggest+detail flow already observed (~0.13s per fund).

All 36 debt funds with moneycontrol_imid have credit_quality_score and duration_risk_score persisted; ytm and modified_duration are null in the sample observed — main agent should confirm whether YTM is intentionally not parsed from the current Moneycontrol layout (parse_investment_style only returns cq/dr) or pending in a follow-up.

Category filter in admin endpoint relies on `category` field; debt funds correctly bucket as Short Duration / Low Duration / Ultra Short Duration / Liquid / Corporate Bond / Debt and route through the debt weights branch.
